title: W7 F1 -- Caret hides behind the ruler when page view is zoomed (WebKit)
description: See docs/agent-work/2026-11-04-ui-wave-7/REVIEW-r3.md section T242. ProseMirror compares a zoomed-space caret rect with an unzoomed scroller, and the Writer.tsx scroll margin is fixed at any zoom. Fix so the caret stays below the ruler at every zoom, in page and continuous view, ruler on or off. Candidate: handleScrollToSelection. Check ruler-off below zoom 1 too.

handoff.text: Tests only; src/caretScroll.ts is correct, do not change it. In tests/ruler.spec.ts change run("ArrowUp", 30) to 70. Why: at 75% the 30 Ups never reach the ruler (0 scroll moves in all 4 tests, closest caret 8 to 194 px), so the upward scroll at the reported zoom is untested. Measured on a scratch copy with 70: real code passes all 4 (min 5), handler off fails continuous and pages ruler on (-18), margin ignored fails both (-13, up to 31 hidden). Then rerun the emulated tests and the handler-off mutant. Held up: fail-first claims (handler off 3 key tests, node branch image 75 only), handler runs on every key (46 of 46), node branch correct, 10x run 100/100. Intermittent miss explained: prosemirror-view only scrolls if selectionchange lands within 50 ms of keydown (dist/index.js:5129); a 120 ms stall reproduces it, also at zoom 100 without the handler, so not a T243 defect; the worker's one miss having this cause is inferred. Node taller than the window ends with its top behind the ruler, same as the default (dist/index.js:233-234), unowned. Emulation, not native proof. Details: REVIEW-r3.md 'T243 r2'.

review.note: Test-only change matches REVIEW-r3 T243 r2, whose reviewer verified 70 Ups against real code and mutants on a scratch copy. 35 passed on a fresh build. App code approved by that review; native confirmation pending in T242.

log.note: App fix: new src/caretScroll.ts (handleScrollToSelection prop in Writer.tsx editorProps): when the shared probe says rects are zoomed-space and total zoom != 1 it scrolls in drawn px (pure scrollDelta/drawnSpan), else returns false so PM default (Chromium) is unchanged. Writer.tsx scrollMargin effect now uses the ruler's DRAWN height (rect.height * totalZoom when probe true). floating.ts: only added export to reportsUnzoomedRects/totalZoom. Fail-first: src/caretScroll.test.ts with drawnSpan naive -> 8 of 20 failed (all WebKit-model cases, Chromium-model 12 passed); fixed -> 20/20. tsc clean; npm test 69 files 1157 pass; Playwright (ui7-e, port 1936) ruler, pages, pages-zoom, pages-gap, page-break, scrollspy, writing: 86 passed, exit 0 (t243.log), incl. 4 new tests/ruler.spec.ts 75% zoom caret tests (Chromium unchanged). Smoke build compiled under lock (t243-smoke.log), NOT run. Native must confirm: ArrowUp at 75% and 84% page view, ruler on and off, one and two panes, zoom 150%, caret clear of ruler and not above scroller top.

One defect. src/caretScroll.ts:37 always uses coordsAtPos(selection.head, 1); ProseMirror's default, which this handler replaces, uses the node's own rect for a NodeSelection. On WebKit at zoom != 1 a selected image is scrolled by the line after it, so it can stay behind the ruler: WebKit-model run (real handler, Chromium with rects patched to drawn/zoom), image top clearance from ruler after setNodeSelection + scrollIntoView: zoom 100 default -19 -> +5; zoom 75 handler -10 -> -10, not moved. Fix: for a NodeSelection take the span from view.nodeDOM(from)'s rect through drawnSpan. Add a test that runs handleCaretScroll: it has never executed in any test (caretScroll.test.ts only runs drawnSpan/scrollDelta and its WebKit model is drawnSpan's inverse; the 4 ruler.spec tests return false in Chromium). The rect patch to reuse is in node_modules/.cache/personal-word-beta/ui7-rv-f/scratch-specs/emu.spec.ts. Everything else held up: same model, 60 Up + 40 Down, pages and continuous, 75 and 150, ruler on/off: 0 hidden (old path up to 3 hidden, -38.7 px, and 3700 px off at 150); split panes, doc end, jumps fine; zoom 1 and Chromium unchanged. Keep src/caretScroll.ts otherwise. Suite: tsc, unit, 484 Playwright passed, 0 failed. Details: REVIEW-r3.md 'T243 T244'. Emulation, not native proof.
